title: Un-pausing a new gym marks it as checked
what: A gym that was never checked, then paused and un-paused, comes back as checked. Nobody looked at it, and the "Mark as checked" button is gone.
expected: Un-pausing puts the gym back to the status it had before the pause.
how_often: every time a new gym is paused before it is checked
fix_line: Un-pause back to the status the gym had before

title: The read-log warning vanishes when a page fails to load
what: When a page fails to load, the error note replaces the whole page, including the read-log warning that should be on top of every page.
expected: The warning stays on top of the error page too.
how_often: only when a page fails while the read log is failing
fix_line: Keep the warning above the error note
